name: Météo-France Vigilance
description: Official real-time Météo-France vigilance feed for mainland France and French overseas territories. Retrieves the current JSON warning map and explanatory bulletins. Access is free after self-service portal signup and API subscription; the integration automatically exchanges the portal application identifier for a one-hour OAuth token.

credential_fields.name: application_id
credential_fields.label: Météo-France application identifier
credential_fields.description: Create an application at portail-api.meteofrance.fr, subscribe it to Bulletin Vigilance, and copy the APPLICATION_ID value used with HTTP Basic authentication.

tools.name: get_current_warning_map
tools.description: Get the latest mainland-France vigilance map as structured JSON, including warning color and phenomenon timelines for each department and coastline domain for day J and J+1.

tools.name: get_current_warning_texts
tools.description: Get the latest explanatory vigilance bulletins as JSON. This product is not emitted on every map update, so compare meta.product_datetime with get_current_warning_map before using it.

tools.name: get_overseas_control
tools.description: Get the latest overseas-vigilance control file metadata used to detect whether the DROM vigilance bundle changed.
